Validator 2 is the only one where M is single digit. Some code can be buggy for single-digit results, so it would be nice if you added another such test case, like "24 9" (or any other 2X 9 test)

Nice clash otherwise!
It is not that important but I think test cases should also include a solution where m>n

✅ Approved the contribution.
Comment: I like the idea, I racked my brains on the IDE for a while to really understand the issue of this CoC... my English blocked me in understanding the exercise, but that's in no way your fault!
I agree with your idea, I find it very interesting! It only remains to see how the players will react to it. 

(Tested in Python3)

=)

Comment: For fastest implementation.

interesting !
But it can be done too quickly.
I suggest you add the edge case where there is no solution by printing NONE or something like that.
9 seems to be smallest where there is a solution in the given range.
